d:
In this episode, we have the renowned author Chetan Bhagat, the man behind Five Point Someone and The 3 Mistakes of My Life. He opens up about his controversies with Urfi Javed & Twinkle Khanna, his views on porn ban, and shares insights on Bigg Boss & Nach Baliye!
